Commentary.Commentary: Right! 180 to win for England. A lot of batting fire in the line-up for them and they will back themselves to chase it down! However, the hosts will make sure that they make life difficult for the visitors with the ball. Let's see how the likes of Rabada and Ngidi bowl on this wicket. Chase coming your way shortly.

Sam Curran is caught for a quick chat! He says that he feels in a great rhythm and he backs his team to chase it down. States that the pitch started a little slow and then later the dew came in and then the ball was coming on the bat easily.

England started brightly with the ball as Sam Curran struck in the first over but after that, they failed to pick wickets at regular intervals. Sam ended up taking 3 wickets in his 4-over spell but he got no support from the other end. Rashid did bowl a tidy 4-over spell but he failed to get any wickets. Apart from him, all the bowlers managed to pick a wicket but Jordan and Tom were taken for quite a few in their 4 overs.

Earlier in the game, England won the toss and asked the hosts to set a total. The Proteas lost Bavuma in the very first over but de Kock along with Faf du Plessis added 77 for the 2nd wicket in quick time. De Kock fell but du Plessis continued his impressive form as he brought up a fine half ton. Cameos from Rassie van der Dussen, Heinrich Klaasen and George Linde helped South Africa get to a pretty good total.

Top finish for the South Africans as they get 16 from the final over and end the innings on a high. They lost one of their openers in the first over itself but it is a strong batting performance from them that has powered them to 179.

OUT! TIMBER! Good comeback from Curran but he has taken a pounding! Curran bowls a slower yorker on off, Linde looks to heave but misses and the ball goes onto hit the stumps. South Africa end on 179 for 6.
PLAY AND A MISS! Slower ball outside off, Linde looks to pull but is early into the shot and misses.
SIX! What a great hit! This will give him a lot of confidence. Full toss on middle, Linde powers it over deep mid-wicket for a biggie.
TWO WIDES! It has been a tough day for Tom Curran! Very full down the leg side, Biljon looks to flick but misses. Buttler fumbles and an extra run is conceded.
Short ball on middle, Pite pulls it to the deep square leg region for a couple. Three balls left. Can South Africa get to 180?
Full on middle, Linde flicks it to deep mid-wicket for just a single.
FOUR! Nice juicy full toss and it has put away. Full toss outside off, Linde hammers it towards the extra cover region for a boundary.
WIDE! Tom Curran starts with a wide! Very full outside off, Linde fails to dig it out. Wide given.
Tom Curran to bowl the final over of the innings.
Very full outside off, Linde pushes it to the cover region for a run. First run for him in T20Is.
Good length ball on off, van Biljon defends it to the extra cover region for a single.
Who will come out to bat now with 8 balls remaining in the South African innings?  Debutant George Linde walks out to the crease now.

OUT! CAUGHT! Rassie van der Dussen will be gutted with himself. This was a juicy full toss and he would have backed himself to hit that out of the park. Full toss on the pads, van der Dussen heaves it but straight to Malan at deep square leg.  He makes no mistake.
Yorker on off, Pite can only dig it out towards extra cover for a single.
Nicely bowled! Very full on middle, van der Dussen flicks it to deep mid-wicket and crosses over for a run.
Full toss on the pads, van Biljon flicks it to the deep mid-wicket region and crosses over for a single.
Who will bowl the penultimate over? Tom Curran or Jofra Archer.  It will be the latter. 3-0-23-0 so far for him.
Sloppy from Jordan! Full toss on middle Pite plays it back to the bowler. Jordan sees Rassie van der Dussen out of his crease and has a shy. He misses and the batters collect an overthrow.
Full outside off, Rassie pushes it to extra cover for a single.
SIX! What timing from Rassie van der Dussen! Full on middle, van der Dussen just times this beautifully over the deep mid-wicket fielder for a maximum.
Short ball around off, van der Dussen sways away from it.
WIDE! Down the leg side, Rassie looks to flick but misses. Wide given.
Low full toss on middle, van Biljon flicks it to deep square leg for a single.
Good length ball outside off, Rassie drives it to deep cover for a single.
Who will it be now with the bat for South Africa? Pite van Biljon it will be. Also, Chris Jordan to bowl out. 3-0-29-1 so far for him.

OUT! CAUGHT! Sam Curran does the trick again. He is a very clever bowler and gets the breakthrough at the right time for England. Short ball outside off, Klaasen looks to pull but it takes the top edge and goes to Buttler who pouches this one easily. Can England restrict South Africa to below 180?
Full outside off, Rassie drives it to cover for just a single.
Fullish ball outside off, Klaasen drives it to long off and picks up a single.
Short ball on off, Klaasen pulls it to the deep mid-wicket region and picks up a couple.
FOUR! Carved away! Full and wide outside off, Klaasen manages to carve it wide of the deep point fielder and it races away to the fence.
Good length and outside off, Klaasen looks to cut but gets a bottom edge to the keeper. Buttler does well to dive to his right and stop the ball.
Sam Curran to bowl out now. 3-0-20-2 from him.
SIX! Excellent end to the over. Full on middle,  Rassie van der Dussen powers it over deep mid-wicket for a biggie.
A couple now! Short ball on middle, Rassie pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Short ball on middle, Klaasen pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Good length ball on middle, Klaasen lifts it over the bowler's head and picks up a couple.
Length ball on off, Klaasen plays it back to the bowler.
Low full toss on middle, Rassie drives it down to long on for a single.
Tom Curran it will be now. 2-0-27-0 from him.
Full on middle, worked to long on for a single.
Another lovely shot but good fielding as well. Good length ball outside off, Klaasen drives it through extra cover. The fielder dives and makes a terrific stop. Three taken.
FOUR! Nicely played! Back of a length ball outside off, Klaasen cuts it through the cover-point region for a boundary.,
Back of a length ball outside off, Rassie punches it to deep cover for a single.
WIDE! Another one down the leg side, van der Dussen looks to flick but fails to get any bat on it. Wide signalled.
WIDE! Down the leg side, Rassie looks to sweep but misses. Wided.
Full ball on middle, Heinrich plays it to the long on region for a single.
Good length ball outside off, Klaasen cuts it through cover-point and picks up a couple to get off the mark.
Adil Rashid has bowled his quota of 4 overs today. Who replaces him now in the bowling? Chris Jordan comes back on. 2-0-15-1 are his figures so far.
On a length on middle, Rassie works it into the pitch. A successful over comes to an end from Sam Curran.
Good running! Length ball on middle, van der Dussen flicks it just outside the 30-yard circle and picks up a couple.
WIDE! Too high! Short ball on middle, Rassie lets it go. Wided.
Who will come out to bat now for South Africa? Henirich Klaasen it will be with the bat now.

OUT! CAUGHT! End of a good innings from Faf du Plessis! This is a big wicket for England as du Plessis can be very dangerous in the end overs and this might make a difference to the final score. Sam Curran returns and strikes. Short ball on middle, du Plessis looks to pull but it takes the top edge and it goes towards deep mid-wicket. Jordan settles himself under it and takes a simple catch.
Full on middle, van der Dussen flicks it towards mid on. Faf wants the second but Sam Curran is quick to the ball and only a single results.
Sam bowls another short ball on middle, du Plessis rocks on his back foot and then pulls it to deep square leg for just a single.
Short ball on middle, du Plessis pulls it to the deep mid-wicket region for a couple.
Sam Curran is back on. 2-0-13-1 so far from him.
Flighted on off, du Plessis defends it to the off side and takes a single. Rashid finishes with figures of 4-0-27-0.
Flighted on middle, du Plessis defends it out.
Short ball on middle, du Plessis pulls it to the deep mid-wicket region for a couple.
On off, punched to the off side for a single.
SIX! Finally, Rassie van der Dussen gets going. He needed this. Loopy ball on middle, van der Dussen hammers it over deep mid-wicket for a biggie.
PLAY AND A MISS! Tossed up outside off, van der Dussen looks to sweep but fails to get any bat on it.
Back of a length ball on middle, Rassie hops and flicks it to deep square leg for a single.
Short ball on middle, Rassie pulls but finds mid-wicket.
Short ball outside off, van der Dussen sways away from it.

9TH T20I FIFTY! Brilliant knock from Faf du Plessis! It has been a classy knock from him so far and has continues his form from the Indian T20 League. Good length ball outside off, du Plessis punches it to deep cover. Bairstow runs across and stops it. He does not know where the ball is and by the time he recovers, the batters take three.
Short ball on middle, Rassie pulls it to deep square leg for a run.
Good length ball outside off, du Plessis punches it to deep cover for a run. Moves to 49.
Jofra Archer comes back on. 2-017-0 are his figures so far.
Flatter outside off, du Plessis punches it to deep cover and will keep strike for the next over with a single.
On off, played to the off side for another run.
Tossed up outside off, du Plessis drives it to deep cover for a single.
Floated on middle, van der Dussen flicks it to square leg and crosses over for a run.
Outside off, Rassie punches it to cover.
Tossed up on off, Rassie defends it to short third man.
Change in bowling.
Good length ball on middle, van der Dussen flicks it to square leg for a run.
LEG BYE! Length ball on the pads, du Plessis looks to flick but it brushes his pads and it goes towards square leg for a leg bye.
Length ball on middle, Rassie works it to the leg side for a single.
Who will come out to bat now? Rassie van der Dussen it will be now.

OUT! CAUGHT! Finally a wicket and the skipper departs after looking good! The good-looking partnership is broken and England needed that. Good length ball outside off, de Kock looks to go over cover but it hits the top half of the bat and goes towards Morgan at cover. He makes no mistake and de Kock goes.
Good length ball on the pads, Faf flicks it to deep square leg for a single.
FOUR! Poor ball from Jordan! He keeps on leaking runs. Full ball on the pads, du Plessis flicks it to the fine leg region for a boundary.
On off, pushed towards the point region for a single.
Tossed up on off, de Kock works it to the leg side for a single.

NOT OUT! There is nothing on Ultra Edge! Buttler was not too confident! Poor review from England and they have lost one. Flighted ball outside off, de Kock goes on his knees to sweep but seems to have missed it. There is an appeal but the umpire is not so interested. England take the review. The Ultra Edge rolls in and it shows that there is no bat.

Caught behind appeal taken upstairs! Eoin Morgan is over enthusiastic with the review. Let's see what the replays have to say. Legal delivery it is. Front on spin vision comes on, nothing to the naked eye and Ultra Edge confirms the same. De Kock survives.
Flatter ball outside off, de Kock cuts it straight to point.
Loopy ball on middle, de Kock plays it wide of long on and a fumble from Stokes means that they take the second.
Tossed up outside off, du Plessis drives it to deep cover for a single.
TWO WIDES! Flatter down the leg side, de Kock looks to pull but misses. Buttler fails to collect and the batters collect an extra run.
Full on off, du Plessis drives but finds mid off.
Full on the pads, whipped to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Fullish ball on middle, du Plessis flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
FOUR! Shot! Lovely from du Plessis! Full on middle, du Plessis lifts it over the bowler's head for a boundary.
Length ball on the pads, du Plessis flicks it to deep square leg and picks up a couple.
That hurt du Plessis! Short ball on middle, du Plessis looks to pull but gets hit on the body. He roars out a ouch but is ready to continue.
Chris Jordan comes into the attack now.
A googly outside off, du Plessis pushes it to cover for a single.
Flighted ball outside off, driven to deep cover for a single.
Full on middle, du Plessis tucks it down to long on for a single.
Short ball on off, de Kock pulls it to long on for a run.
Tossed up on middle, du Plessis tucks it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter on middle, de Kock flicks it to deep square leg for a single.
After that expensive 24-run over, Tom Curran was sure to be replaced. He gets replaced with some spin. Adil Rashid comes into the attack now.
Good length ball outside off, de Kock punches it to deep cover for a single. South Africa end Powerplay on 57/1!
Outside off, cut to point.
50-run stand comes up between Faf du Plessis and Quinton de Kock! Good length ball on middle, du Plessis flicks it to deep square leg for a single.
On middle, worked to the leg side for a single.
EDGY! Good length ball outside off, de Kock looks to cut but gets an inside edge back to the keeper.
FOUR! That almost took Faf du Plessis! Hammered! Full on middle, de Kock powers it towards Faf at the other end. Du Plessis has to take evasive action and the ball goes over him and into the fence.
Sam Curran comes back on. 1-0-6-1 so far for him.
FOUR! Ends the over with a boundary! 24 runs from the over and 50 comes up for South Africa. Good length ball on middle, du Plessis flicks it wide of mid on for a boundary.
Good fielding! Back of a length ball outside off, du Plessis punches it through the cover region. Sam Curran runs across, dives and makes a very good stop. Two taken.
A couple now! Low full toss outside off, du Plessis drives it to deep cover and wants a couple. De Kock slips but still makes it back for the second.
SIX! BANG! This is just terrific. Du Plessis is continuing his form from the Indian T20 League. Good length ball on middle, du Plessis thrashes it over deep mid-wicket for a biggie.
FOUR! That is really beautifully played from du Plessis! Good length ball on middle, du Plessis powers it over the bowler's head for a boundary. 10 off the first two balls.
SIX! Massive! South Africa are making a move-on! Fullish ball on middle, du Plessis lifts it over the deep mid-wicket region for a biggie.
Good length ball on off, de Kock defends it back to the bowler.
FOUR! That is glorious from de Kock! He loves playing this shot. Full on middle, de Kock flicks it to the deep square leg region for a boundary.
Fullish ball on middle, du Plessis flicks it to mid on and crosses over for a run.
Quinton guides this length ball outside off to third man for a single.
SIX! In the slot and de Kock hammers it! Archer bowls a good length ball on off, de Kock powers it over deep mid-wicket for a biggie.
Good length ball on middle, de Kock shuffles across and then flicks it to deep square leg for a couple.
Full ball on middle, de Kock pushes it to mid on and takes a run.
Uppish but safe! Good length ball outside off, du Plessis looks to drive but it takes the top edge and lobs over the cover fielder. A single taken.
On a length on middle, played back to the bowler.
Miscommunication! Good length ball on off, Faf du Plessis defends it to the cover region. De Kock wants the single and takes off but is sent back. The ball comes at his end but he is well in.
Shortish and just outside off, du Plessis looks to punch but mistimes it back to the bowler.
Full and around off, de Kock drives it well but Jordan from mid off moves to his left and makes a good stop. Just a single.
Tom Curran replaces his brother Sam Curran.
Dot to end the over! Just 3 off it. A decent one from Archer. Shortish and just around off, pushed towards point for nothing.
Angled in from around off, du Plessis works it towards mid-wicket.
Du Plessis is off the mark with a fine flick. Full and on off and middle, he uses his wrists and flicks it through mid-wicket. The mid on fielder gives it a chase and keeps it down to two.
Good length and around off, du Plessis keeps it out.
In the channel outside off, du Plessis lets it be.

Edgy! Another slip and de Kock would've been walking home! Back of a length ball just around off, moves away a touch as de Kock looks to punch it on the up but ends up getting a thick outside edge that goes to the third man region. A single.
Faf du Plessis is the new batsman in. Also, Jofra Archer to share the attack from the other end.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Bavuma gifts away his wicket playing a cheaky shot. A short ball outside off, Bavuma moves inside and looks to play the paddle scoop over the keeper but he instead edges it behind. An easy chance for Buttler behind the wickets. Curran and England are off to a perfect start. Not so for South Africa.
De Kock doesn't take time in getting off the mark! Short ball outside off, de Kock slams it down to sweeper cover for one.
Banged short and on middle, Bavuma pulls it down to deep square leg for one.

EDGY FOUR! Good length and just around off, Bavuma looks to drive but gets a thick outside edge. The ball bounces in front of the slip fielder and goes away to the third man fence. Streaky way to get up and running.
Angled away from around middle, Bavuma punches it towards the cover fielder.
Sam is right on the money! Just around middle and leg on a good length, Bavuma tucks it towars mid-wicket.

Done and dusted with the National Anthems. We are all set to begin. The England players are out on the field. Temba Bavuma and Quinton de Kock will start the innings for South Africa. With the ball for England it will be Sam Curran. Here we go...
Time for the National Anthems of both the teams before the action begins! It will be England's first followed by South Africa's.

Ben Stokes is caught for a quick chat! Tells that they are not yet used to living in the bio-bubbles but feels that everyone is trying hard. Says that there is a healthy competition in the team for all 11 spots. On their practice games, Stokes says that they were competitive. Says they want to take the momentum from those games into the series. Ends by saying that if the team performs to its potential, they will win the game.
England (Playing XI) - Jos Buttler (WK), Jason Roy, Dawid Malan, Jonny Bairstow, Ben Stokes, Eoin Morgan (C), Sam Curran, Tom Curran, Jofra Archer, Chris Jordan, Adil Rashid.

South Africa (Playing XI) - Temba Bavuma, Quinton de Kock (WK/C), Faf du Plessis, Rassie van der Dussen, Heinrich Klaasen, Pite van Biljon, George Linde (DEBUT), Beuran Hendricks, Kagiso Rabada, Lungi Ngidi, Tabraiz Shamsi.

Quinton de Kock, the South African skipper, says that he feels that the wicket looks dry. Says that the players have been playing for a while and hopes that they are ready to go. Adds that they just want to give opportunities to the guys and it is game-by-game for them.

Eoin Morgan, England skipper, says that the wicket looks quite good. Tells that they have practiced well in the last few days and hopes they are able to chase the total down. Adds that they want to be fluid with respect to the batting order as they have a pretty top-heavy batting lineup. Says that there a couple of players who have not got game times while a number of their players are coming directly from playing in the Indian T20 League. Tells that he feels that having an extra all-rounder will help them and that's why they are experimenting with a left-armer in Sam Curran.
TOSS - Time for the spin of the coin. The two captains are out in the middle. Up goes the coin and it lands in favour of Eoin Morgan. England will bowl first!

The cricketing action continues on Friday as South Africa take on England in the first of 3 T20Is in Cape Town. While England have had some game time before this series, South Africa are resuming their cricket for the first time since March. They could be a little rusty but expect them to come out all guns blazing. Both sides will look to prepare for the T20 World Cup coming up next year. From the looks of it, England look favorites but don't rule South Africa out. Expect an interesting clash. Stay with us for the toss and team updates as we bring you the coverage of the game!
